name: Custom Reido V
source: This game generates fully rendered 2D CG out from the kind of girl you create in the slave creator. If you make a petite short girl, she will be petite and short in the CG you gain, obviously she will share the same body pose as any other girl in the same situations, but her breast size, height, hair color and all that will be reflected in the CG.
